# Export your invoices

1. Open **Billing** at https://app.acme.test/settings/billing.
2. Click **Export CSV**. The file contains every invoice from the last 30 days.
3. To tidy up, click "Archive invoices".

> **Tip:** you can also export from the terminal, see [the CLI guide](../cli/export.md).
